en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a lively street scene with horse-drawn carriages and people gathered in front of a building labeled "HÔTEL ANCORA." To the left stands a prominent church or clock tower with crenellations at the top. The image is framed by handwritten text in an old cursive script along the right and bottom margins. The word "Cavalese" and a date are printed or written in red at the top right.
